reason: The hypothesis relies on a VEC–Tc relationship, but the cited evidence does not clearly establish that lowering VEC via Ti substitution increases Tc in bcc HEAs. E1 notes Ti-rich alloys have higher Hc2 but does not link this to VEC or Tc enhancement; E2 mentions a VEC framework but for a different system and does not show Ti-driven Tc increase; E3 discusses VEC for phase stability, not superconductivity; E4 mentions VEC–Tc trends but notes opposite behavior in some HEAs. The premises are thus only loosely or indirectly supported.
